camel_example: aliyun cloudapi SetDomainCertificate --region cn-hangzhou --CertificateBody '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_CERTIFICATE-----' --SslVerifyDepth 2 --DomainName 'api.demo.com' --ClientCertSDnPassThrough true --CaCertificateBody CA_certificate_encoding_content --SslOcspCacheEnable true --CertificatePrivateKey '-----BEGIN_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----' --CertificateName test_cert --GroupId 927d50c0f2e54b359919923d908bb015 --SslOcspEnable true
description_en: Uploads an SSL certificate for a specified custom domain name
description_zh: 为指定自定义域名上传SSL证书
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi set-domain-certificate --group-id 927d50c0f2e54b359919923d908bb015 --domain-name api.demo.com --certificate-name test_cert --certificate-body -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --certificate-private-key -----BEGIN_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY-----_MIIEpAIBAAKCAQEA8GjIleJ7rlo86mtbwcDnUfqzTQAm4b3zZEo1aKsfAuwcvCud_...._-----END_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY----- --ca-certificate-body CA_certificate_encoding_content --ssl-verify-depth 2 --ssl-ocsp-enable true --ssl-ocsp-cache-enable true --client-cert-s-dn-pass-through true --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
